$description: Tier 1 · Global primitives. Raw values only. Emitted as --g-*. Never referenced by components directly; semantic tokens alias these.

neutral.$description: Neutral ramp, slightly cool (hue 260) so long reading sessions feel calm.

450.$description: Control borders in light mode (--input): 3.4:1 on white, over the 3:1 a field's edge needs (WCAG 1.4.11).

blue.$description: Accent hues. 500 is the light-mode step, 400 the dark-mode step (lighter, so it keeps contrast on dark surfaces).

600.$description: Blue as text in light mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.0, .50 and .100 (page, chrome, selected rows).

300.$description: Blue as text in dark mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.950, .900 and .800.

600.$description: Coral as text in light mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.0, .50 and .100 (page, chrome, selected rows).

300.$description: Coral as text in dark mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.950, .900 and .800.

600.$description: Green as text in light mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.0, .50 and .100 (page, chrome, selected rows).

300.$description: Green as text in dark mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.950, .900 and .800.

600.$description: Amber as text in light mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.0, .50 and .100 (page, chrome, selected rows).

450.$description: The light-mode warning fill: its label (neutral.950) Lc 62, the fill Lc 31 or more against the page, the sidebar and a selected row.

300.$description: Amber as text in dark mode: Lc 75 or more on neutral.950, .900 and .800.

700.$description: Destructive text in light mode: Lc 76 or more on neutral.0, .50 and .100 (a selected row), 75 on its own 10% tint.

600.$description: Destructive text in light mode for tokens 0.4-0.6 (Lc 84 on white, 74 on a selected row). --destructive now uses red.700; kept unchanged for anything that points here.

300.$description: Destructive text in dark mode for tokens 0.4-0.6 (Lc 76 on neutral.900, 74 on a selected row). --destructive now uses red.200; kept unchanged for anything that points here.

200.$description: Destructive text in dark mode: Lc 76 or more on neutral.950, .900 and .800 (a selected row), 72 on its own 20% tint.

white-alpha.$description: Translucent white, for hairlines on dark surfaces (shadcn's dark border/input). Alpha in the name is a percentage.

35.$description: Control borders in dark mode (--input): 3.1:1 or more on neutral.900 and neutral.950.

hue.$description: Bare hue angles for tinted surfaces. Lightness and chroma are semantic, so one hue gives a pastel wash in light mode and a deep one in dark.
